stem: The ARPA of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription, rose from €42 to €45 over a quarter in which no prices changed and no business changed plan. Its monthly plans cost €40 and €65. Which of these could explain the rise?

options.text: Many new businesses joined on the €40 plan
Several businesses on the €40 plan cancelled
Business Care Year plans were counted at a twelfth of their fee
Several businesses on the €65 plan cancelled
